kept.name: storybloq
kept.reason: File-based project-state and memory system for coding agents that overlaps heavily with kb wiki; the entry already has a feature table comparing record types, relations, search and the Lessons reinforce/digest lifecycle.

kept.name: codegraph
kept.reason: Builds a deterministic knowledge graph in SQLite and serves it to agents through a single MCP explore tool, so it's a close match for the graph side of your design.

kept.name: jcode
kept.reason: Agent memory that embeds each turn, retrieves by cosine similarity and consolidates in the background, which is a reference for the embedding layer you're adding.

kept.name: mycelium
kept.reason: Versioned context store plus semantic-memory and auto-memory plugins behind MCP, an alternative design for persistent agent memory.

kept.name: mistakes-md-log
kept.reason: Plain markdown memory with no vector store, where repeated entries get promoted into hard rules; useful as the simplest baseline to compare against.

kept.name: embodied-agent-design-patterns
kept.reason: Lessons on persistent memory: contradictions build up over time, so it recommends periodic consolidation and giving each record a source, last-confirmed date and invalidation method.

kept.name: bmad-skill-forge
kept.reason: Its tiers move from lexical/AST indexing to semantic search with hybrid indexing (cocoindex-code), a similar staged path from lexical to hybrid.

kept.name: microsoft-eval-guide
kept.reason: Its RAG evaluation tier covers retrieval accuracy, grounding and hallucination, which you could use to check whether adding embeddings actually improves retrieval.

kept.name: six-ai-engineer-projects
kept.reason: A RAG and evals lesson: put a recall gate in CI that fails the pull request when recall drops, which applies to testing retrieval quality during the hybrid-search rollout.

kept.name: seb-ocr
kept.reason: Uses embedding cosine similarity to deduplicate entities, a technique you could reuse to find duplicate or contradicting memory records.

kept.name: huggingface-inference-providers
kept.reason: Embedding and feature-extraction API with a free tier, one practical way to generate the semantic embeddings for records.

kept.name: awesome-harness-engineering
kept.reason: Curated list that includes a section on context management and memory systems, a starting point for finding comparable designs.

kept.name: community-skills-stack-2026
kept.reason: Its memory section lists Obsidian skills and planning-with-files, existing markdown-based approaches to agent memory.

kept.name: crawl4ai
kept.reason: RAG ingestion with BM25-filtered markdown and chunking strategies; mostly about ingestion rather than retrieval.

kept.name: opendataloader-pdf
kept.reason: Converts PDFs to RAG-ready output with bounding boxes for source citations; relevant if documents get pulled into the knowledge base.

kept.name: build-ai-agents-free
kept.reason: Beginner LangGraph example of conversation memory using a checkpointer and thread_id, a minimal baseline for agent memory.
